MUSIC AND DANCE — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Western Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Western Instruments.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Western Instruments.
   C. Practise Western Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Western Instruments.

   D. Damage equipment used for Four-Part Harmony.
